title: 第9章 逃生之机第10章 死亡
slug: 凡人修仙谁能比我极阴更阴
content_zh:
在简单思索一阵之后，极阴又从怀中摸出了一本小册子，扔给了宋文。
“这是为师自行总结的灵药培育经验，你拿回去好生观看，从今日开始，东边的那块灵田就由你负责，只要能管理好，半月后，整片灵田都会交于你打理，到时为师会赐予你天大的好处。”
西边灵田中种植的是赤箭、芫花，是炼制气血丹的辅药，在盐城的深山中就能找到，算不得珍贵。
交给宋文试手，极阴也放心。
至于极阴口中承诺的好处，那本就只是一种忽悠，在他看来，让宋文多活两年，已是天大的恩赐。
“多谢师尊，弟子一定竭尽全力培育，不负师尊的期待。”
宋文接过手札，恭敬的说道。
宋文拿着两本书籍出了二楼，接了灵药种植的活，他一时也没法判定是好还是不好。
“努力将灵草种好吧，也许这会延迟自己试药的时间。”
宋文心中默念道。
返回房间之后，宋文先是看了极阴记录的种植经验的手札，极阴一共只种植了八种灵药，全部是炼制气血丹所需。
然后又翻看了《低阶灵草种植详解》，将极阴种植的八种灵草全部找出，然后一一对应，心中默默琢磨着灵草种植之法。
在心中有一定理论基础之后，宋文来到了东边的药田。
这块药田不大，约有半亩左右。
极阴将灵田照料得不错，分行成陇，稀疏种植了赤箭、芫花各三十株。
宋文在灵田之中细心查看，顺带拔出了少量的杂草。
他对灵药进行逐一查看，进行了编号，并记录在册，对每株灵药的长势和浇水情况，进行了详细的记录。
十天后，将这一切都看在眼中的极阴，将整个药田交给了宋文打理。
而极阴本人再一次闭关，他要再次炼制气血丹了。
在反复叮嘱宋文一定要照料好赤血腾后，极阴进入了炼丹洞府，并关闭了洞府的石门。

赤血腾是炼制气血丹最主要的原料，也是最难寻找的灵药，当初他为了找赤血腾，动用天煞帮的力量，几乎翻遍了大半个乾国，才找出这么一株五十年份的赤血腾，他每次炼药，都只敢取少些枝条，生怕影响到赤血腾的生长。
从二牛口中得知，极阴每次闭关炼丹，都需要十天以上，宋文的内心变得激动起来，他感觉逃跑的机会即将到来。
宋文不动声色的走入药田中的一间小木屋，这里放置着种植灵药所需的农具。
宋文在木屋中翻找，想要找到一些能帮助自己逃离的工具，结果翻找一圈下来，除了常见的农具以外，宋文没有发现任何有用的东西。
不过，他找到了一把二十公分长的匕首。
匕首上有皮制剑鞘，取下剑鞘，匕首呈现乌黑之色，剑刃冒着锋利寒芒，摄人心魄。
“好刀！”
宋文心中暗呼一声，他握紧剑柄，朝着木屋的一块木头砍去。
顿时，寸粗的木棍应声而断。
宋文双目精光连连，这匕首绝对属于神兵利器极品，是很好的防身利器。
宋文将匕首插入剑鞘，放入了自己的靴子之中。
又再木屋中寻找一圈，别无发现后，宋文扛着锄头出了木屋。
content_en:
After thinking briefly for a while, Ji Yin took out a pamphlet from his arms and threw it to Song Wen.
"This is the spiritual medicine cultivation experience that I have summarized by myself. You can take it back and watch it. From today on, you will be responsible for the spiritual field in the east. As long as you can manage it well, in half a month, the entire spiritual field will be handed over to you. At that time, I will give you great benefits."
The red arrow and daphne flowers grown in the spiritual fields to the west are auxiliary medicines for refining Qi and Blood Pills. They can be found in the mountains of Yancheng and are not considered precious.
Let Song Wen try his hand, Ji Yin is relieved.
As for the benefits Ji Yin promised, it was just a lie. In his opinion, letting Song Wen live for two more years was already a great gift.
"Thank you Master. I will do my best to cultivate you as a disciple and live up to Master's expectations."
Song Wen took the note and said respectfully.
Song Wen took two books out of the second floor and took over the work of planting the elixir. He couldn't decide whether it was good or bad for the moment.
"Work hard to plant the spiritual herbs. Maybe this will delay your time to test the medicine."
Song Wen thought silently in his heart.
After returning to the room, Song Wen first read Jiyin's handbook of planting experience. Jiyin only planted eight kinds of elixirs in total, all of which were needed to refine Qi and Blood Pills.
Then I read the "Detailed Explanation of Planting Low-level Spiritual Grasses", found all eight kinds of spiritual herbs grown in Jiyin, and then corresponded them one by one, silently pondering the method of planting spiritual herbs in my mind.
After having a certain theoretical foundation in his mind, Song Wen came to the medicine field in the east.
This medicinal field is not big, about half an acre.
Jiyin took good care of the spiritual field, branching it into long rows, and sparsely planting thirty plants each of red arrows and daphne.
Song Wen carefully inspected the spiritual field and pulled out a few weeds.
He checked the elixirs one by one, numbered them, and recorded them in a book. He also made detailed records of the growth and watering conditions of each elixir plant.
Ten days later, Ji Yin, who saw all this in his eyes, handed over the entire medicinal field to Song Wen to take care of.
And Jiyin himself went into seclusion again, and he was going to refine Qi and Blood Pills again.
After repeatedly telling Song Wen to take good care of Chixueteng, Jiyin entered the alchemy cave and closed the stone door of the cave.
Red Blood Teng is the most important raw material for refining Qi and Blood Pills, and it is also the most difficult elixir to find. In order to find Red Blood Teng, he used the power of the Tiansha Gang to search almost half of the Qian Kingdom before he found such a 50-year-old Red Blood Teng plant. Every time he refined the medicine, he only dared to take a few branches, for fear of affecting the growth of Red Blood Teng.
After learning from Erniu that every time Jiyin retreats to refine elixirs, it takes more than ten days. Song Wen becomes excited and feels that the opportunity to escape is coming.
Song Wen calmly walked into a small wooden house in the medicine field, where the farm tools needed to grow elixirs were placed.
Song Wen rummaged through the wooden house, hoping to find some tools that could help him escape. After rummaging around, Song Wen found nothing useful except common farm tools.
However, he found a twenty centimeter long dagger.
There is a leather scabbard on the dagger. When you remove the scabbard, the dagger appears jet black, and the blade emits a sharp and cold light, which is breathtaking.
"Good knife!"
Song Wen secretly shouted in his heart. He tightened the hilt of his sword and chopped off a piece of wood in the wooden house.
Suddenly, the thick wooden stick broke with a sound.
Song Wen's eyes were shining brightly. This dagger was definitely a top-notch divine weapon and a very good self-defense weapon.
Song Wen inserted the dagger into the scabbard and put it into his boots.
After searching around the wooden house again and finding nothing, Song Wen walked out of the wooden house with a hoe.
